question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**beyond**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains that the harms of climate change are not limited to one aspect (heat-related health impacts), but extend further.
 
• The correct preposition must convey the idea of surpassing or extending past a certain limit.
 
• The word "**beyond**" (आगे) means ‘on the further side of’ or ‘more than a particular limit,’ which suits the context accurately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Climate change will **affect__* * every aspect of our health and well-being. But its potential harms go * *__beyond__* * the body's ability to handle * *__extreme__* * heat, important as this is. Extreme weather events, such as floods, droughts, storms and wildfires, are becoming more * *__frequent__* * and severe. These affect our mental health in a multitude of ways. Coping with climate change can be overwhelming. It could increase the * *__likelihood__* * of harmful substance use.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Besides** (के अतिरिक्त): Does not convey surpassing a limit, hence contextually weak.
 
• **Between** (के बीच): Refers to a position or range separating two items; grammatically incorrect here.
 
• **Before** (से पहले): Implies time precedence; does not suit the idea of extent or impact.
